radiology_report:
Subject: mpMRI Prostate | Reporting Center: Spaarne Gasthuis, Haarlem | Date: 15 Dec 2024
Indication: Rising serum PSA (4.3 ng/mL) prompting malignancy evaluation.

FINDINGS: Prostatic dimensions record as 4.1 x 3.2 x 1.9 cm, calculating to a total volume of 24.74 mL. T2 sequences identify a 12 mm hypointense focus situated at the right peripheral zone base-to-mid junction. Diffusion-weighted imaging (b-value 1400 s/mm2) shows profound restriction, mirrored by diminished ADC signal. Post-contrast dynamics exhibit early, localized enhancement against background parenchyma. Seminal vesicles maintain normal structure and enhancement patterns. Extraprostatic spread, seminal vesicle invasion, and neurovascular bundle involvement are absent. Imaging reveals no suspicious lymphadenopathy or osseous marrow changes.

IMPRESSION: Focal lesion in the right peripheral zone base/mid gland consistent with PI-RADS 4. Prostate volume 24.74 mL. PSA density 0.174 ng/mL/mL. csPCa predicted probability 0.6793318.
